[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 360
- Description: Thread 35944 — CFR Anapu payout pipeline (executor): overpay-guard rework, coord/photo-hash pipeline, My Trees deep-links, payout-filing recon
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/129
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/130
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/27
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/28
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/29
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint_beta/pull/95
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint_beta/pull/98
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/cfr-anapu/pull/18
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/cfr-anapu/pull/21
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/573
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/574
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/576
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1432
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1452
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dao_protocol/pull/180
  
  Details:
  Executor work for the CFR Anapu / SunMint payout thread (35944), 2026-09-26 → 09-29. ~60 merged PRs across 6 repos, all beta/staging only — no prod deploy, no money moved.
  
  WORKSTREAMS
  1. Overpay-guard rework (P0-C/D) — dapp_beta. Diagnosed why 71 trees were flagged "without a reason"; proved (read-only, live feed) that all 268 co-located pairs had pHash Hamming >=14 → genuinely DISTINCT trees (dense plantation), not duplicates. Changed semantics: flag (i) genuine duplicates (same photo_url / txid / pHash net) and (ii) IDENTICAL-coord collisions only; shipped per-tree REASON inline + tightened OVERPAY_SAME_FIX_METERS 0.5m→0.15m. Live beta flags 71 → 25 → 21.
  2. Coordinate-resolution pipeline — lineage-assets. EXIF > Grok burn-in > submitted priority chain (coord_pipeline.py / coord_resolution.py / burnin_gps.py), 64-bit photo_hash emitter, (msg_id,photo_url,txid) dedup, recipient_pk_hash carry. Feed 147→137 rows, photo_hash on all.
  3. Lat/long backfill — SunMint "Tree Planting" sheet cols K/L, 22 rows (21 burn-in + 1 EXIF), 0 mismatches, backup taken.
  4. My Trees module — sunmint_beta + cfr-anapu. Public-key tree list, expandable cards, ?tree= / ?tx= deep links, keyless public receipt view (so a payee with no key can open a tree), SW self-heal. Re-vendored to cfr-anapu.
  5. Signatures + reactive index — tokenomics GAS. Write signer public key to its own column (col W, backfilled 249 rows, digest-identical), ping tree-index-rebuild on new planting (new trees reach /my-trees/ in minutes, not <=24h), payout-sink composite dedup key (bank_ref, tree_id).
  6. CFR planting record PDFs — 18 trees keyed by transaction ID + public view URLs + TrueSight DAO logo. Caught a real trap: every txid contains '+' and '/', raw form fails → percent-encoded all links; verified 18/18 resolve to exactly one tree via headless browser.
  7. Payout-filing recon — reconciled Gary's R$90 PIX = 18 trees x R$5 (agreement §7); identified the downstream blocker (sink would drive 'Cacao Tree - To Be Paid For' to -16 and book only R$85 of R$90) and laid out resolution options before filing. NOT filed — awaiting governor decision.
  
  EVIDENCE — merged PRs (verified via GitHub API)
  lineage-assets: #25 #26 #27 #28 #29 #30
  dapp_beta: #124 #127 #128 #129 #130 #143
  sunmint_beta: #87 #93 #95 #96 #98 #100 #101
  cfr-anapu: #15 #17 #18 #20 #21 #22
  tokenomics: #562 #563 #573 #574 #576
  agentic_ai_context: #1426 #1429 #1430 #1431 #1432 #1434 #1443 #1452 #1454 #1462
  dao_protocol: #180 (payout-registration dispatch route, verified live)
  
  BOUNDARY NOTE: the Farm/Plot spatial-filter PRs (dapp_beta #144–#147) + the URL-sync unit were already reported under thread 38993 — excluded here to avoid double-count.
  
  Nothing submitted on the payout itself; no ledger write.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 600.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
